cards.subject: A jungle city
lines: Zul'Farrak was one of the Gurubashi Empire's cities, when all of this was rainforest.
The Sundering stranded the Farraki here and they adapted into sand trolls. The building you are standing in is a jungle city that dried out.

cards.subject: Sergeant Bly
lines: His band fled Gadgetzan, wandered into the city and were caged for sacrifice. Free them and they fight the troll rush beside you.
Then you ask about the Divino-matic Rod: "That's it! I'm tired of helping you out. It's time we settled things on the battlefield!"
He only turns if you ask for the rod.

cards.subject: The name is a mutiny
lines: The reading is that he is named for the captain of the Bounty.
It is attached to the one man in this dungeon who mutinies on you.

cards.subject: Weegli always runs
lines: The goblin does not fight. He flees, every time, without fail.
Of the five mercenaries, one has read the room.

cards.subject: The stair event
lines: You and the freed mercenaries hold the pyramid steps against a wave of trolls charging down them.
The Sandfury Executioner is stationed there.
Nekrum Gutchewer has to fall before the way to the chief opens at all.

cards.subject: Witch Doctor Zum'rah
lines: He is not. He turns hostile when you get close enough.
He raises the dead out of the graves in front of him, and the mound of graves is the fight.
It is placed exactly where you would have walked anyway.

cards.subject: Theka the Martyr
cards.tag: Look at what is crawling on him
lines: He was killed in the ancient war between the trolls and the insect empires, protecting his people.
The story told about him is that the curse of his death turned his killers into scarabs.
Those are the scarabs. His murderers, still serving him.

cards.subject: He used to be unkillable
lines: Low on health he goes immune to physical and shadow damage.
Before 1.12 that immunity was permanent — parties could put him in a state where he simply could not be killed.
It is fifteen seconds now. If you are here, you got the fixed one.

cards.subject: Somebody has to ring the gong
cards.tag: And the mallet is not in Tanaris
lines: Gahz'rilla does not spawn on her own. You need the Mallet of Zul'Farrak.
The Sacred Mallet comes from the Altar of Zul in the Hinterlands, and you carry it up Jintha'Alor to transform it.
A different continent, a second dungeon zone, all so one person can hit a gong in the desert.

cards.subject: A god who is not on the list
lines: The Sandfury worship her as a deity — a hydra so fierce her scales crackle with energy.
But she does not appear on the Tablet of Theka among the recognised loa.
Either a demigod the tribe made up, or one the record forgot.

cards.subject: Sul'thraze the Lasher
lines: Sang'thraze the Deflector and Jang'thraze the Protector both drop in here. Combine them and you get the Splitblade of Suffering.
The merge is permanent, eats both swords, and carries no enchants over.
It requires level fifty — well past what you would be clearing this place at.

cards.subject: Antu'sul
lines: A shaman who keeps sul'lithuz basilisks, and the way it is written he treats the scaled things like family.
They are not adds he summons under pressure so much as his household.
They come out as he loses ground.

cards.subject: Three rares in one dungeon
lines: None of them are on the run you planned.
You either see them or you do not.
